name: sol_basics_vi_svi_47
description: Duplicate free-function names/params colliding under buggy Solidity compiler version
question: The source file in `source` declares a pragma solidity version affected by the free-function name-collision bug (e.g. 0.7.1 or another version lacking this fix) and defines two or more free functions (not inside a contract) sharing the same name and identical parameter types, or imports a free function under an alias that shadows another free function with a different name but identical parameter types, relying on the compiler to reject or disambiguate this when it may silently accept the collision.
criteria: Two free functions outside any contract are both named the same, e.g. function foo(uint256 x) and a second function foo(uint256 y), in a file pragma solidity 0.7.1
A free function bar(uint256) is imported and aliased as baz, while another free function baz(uint256) with the same parameter types already exists in the importing file

Multiple free functions with identical name and parameter types are defined across different imported files that are combined via import statements into one source unit, under an affected pragma version
